findings.evidence: Shower.lean:39-43; the replaced text ("needs a symmetrization lemma mathlib does not have") carried no such diff-relative framing.
findings.fix: State the current position only, e.g. "the gap ... is the modelling of the sampler itself: no probability space connects this code's draws to that law. The ordered-integral identity it relies on is `EpsilonEridani.OrderedSimplex.setIntegral_orderedRegion_eq_orderedProdIntegral`."
findings.issue: "the gap ... is not the ordered-integral identity any more (`...setIntegral_orderedRegion_eq_orderedProdIntegral` proves it) but the modelling of the sampler itself" is change-log narrative: "any more" is meaningful only relative to this PR's diff, and a later reader has no referent for what the gap used to be.

findings.evidence: Sudakov.lean:55 vs OrderedSimplexIntegral.lean:194-195 (`orderedRegion ... {p | StrictMono p ∧ ∀ i, p i ∈ Set.Ioo t T}`) and 321-323.
findings.fix: Say which labelling the theorem uses ("over the ordered subset with coordinates listed smallest first") and, if the descending reading is meant, point at `setIntegral_preimage_comp_rev_orderedRegion`.
findings.issue: "its identification with the Lebesgue integral of the product over the ordered subset of `ℝ^n` is `...setIntegral_orderedRegion_eq_orderedProdIntegral`" leaves the labelling unqualified, while the region displayed earlier in the same docstring (line 55) is `T > t₁ > ⋯ > tₙ > t`, largest coordinate first. The cited theorem is stated for `orderedRegion`, i.e. `{p | StrictMono p ∧ ∀ i, p i ∈ Ioo t T}`, smallest first; the reversed labelling needs `setIntegral_preimage_comp_rev_orderedRegion`.

findings.evidence: OrderedSimplexIntegral.lean:410-417; cf. line 61 which correctly writes `q ↦ g (Fin.cons x q)`.
findings.fix: Write "the integral of `q ↦ g (q ∘ Fin.rev)` over the ordered region", matching the form already used in the module docstring for `setIntegral_orderedRegion_succ`.
findings.issue: The docstring says the result "equals the integral of `g ∘ Fin.rev` over the ordered region", but `g : (Fin n → ℝ) → E` and `Fin.rev : Fin n → Fin n`, so `g ∘ Fin.rev` does not typecheck; the statement's integrand is `fun q => g (q ∘ Fin.rev)`.

findings.evidence: StrictMono.lean:11 vs the file's single declaration at line 29-35, `MeasurableSet {p : ι → α | StrictMono p}`.
findings.fix: Retitle to "# Measurable sets of strictly monotone functions".
findings.issue: The module header is "# Measurable sets of monotone functions", but the file proves only `measurableSet_strictMono`, about `{p | StrictMono p}`; `Monotone` is a distinct predicate and no such result is here.

summary: Every new declaration is documented and the OrderedSimplexIntegral module docstring accurately describes the new half, but four docstring texts need fixing: a change-log phrasing in Generator/Shower.lean, an unqualified coordinate orientation in Sudakov.lean, an ill-typed shorthand in setIntegral_preimage_comp_rev_orderedRegion, and a header in StrictMono.lean that promises Monotone while only StrictMono is proved.
